sections.heading: Generic rendering
sections.text: Routes identify the selected site, validate page data, resolve the canonical template, and compose sections through a controlled registry.

sections.heading: Accessibility conventions
sections.text: Semantic landmarks, exactly one H1, native controls, visible focus, focus return, reduced motion, and automated axe scans are framework-level responsibilities.

sections.heading: Prototype data behavior
sections.text: The reference form simulates a result locally and does not persist or transmit visitor data.
